description: Gunter's Space Page is a long-running reference on spaceflight with pages for satellites, launch vehicles and missions and a chronology of launches, each satellite page typically giving the operator, contractors, mission, bus, mass, power, orbit and launch details. Gunter Dirk Krebs established it in 1996 and updates it continuously; the home page lists the newest satellites and launches and was last updated on 29 September 2026. Coverage is global, from the beginning of spaceflight to the present, across commercial, civil and military spacecraft. Format and access: free HTML pages with a citation helper; there is no bulk download or API. Licence: copyright of the author, with terms of use and a notice that the pages may not be used to train machine-learning models; free to read, with optional support by subscription. Caveats: compiled by one person from public sources, so specifications are not authoritative and reuse needs permission. It serves equipment specifications and system descriptions for capacity planning of satellite infrastructure. Related catalogue records are GCAT and the UCS Satellite Database, which give structured tables.
